_comment: Accepted pnpm audit findings. CI fails on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here, and fails once an entry passes its 'expires' date. Remove entries as they are fixed; never extend an expiry without a written reason.

entries.reason: minimatch 3.1.5 (via @eslint/eslintrc and @eslint/config-array, ESLint 9 lint tooling only, never shipped or run on untrusted globs). First patched release is 11.0.1, which drops the CommonJS default export that @eslint/eslintrc imports, so an override breaks `eslint .`. Remove when ESLint/@eslint/eslintrc move to a patched minimatch.
